scenes.description: A learner studies at a desk when a friend enters and starts a friendly greeting.

characters.description: seated at desk with notebook and headphones
friendly peer entering through doorway

physical_cues.world_opener: friend enters, smiles, waves, and makes eye contact
physical_cues.learner_target: learner looks up, waves back, and gestures toward friend

localized_variants.es: home study room or language class desk
localized_variants.ta: home study room in Tamil Nadu

scenes.description: A neighbor pauses at a gate and greets the learner outside.

characters.description: standing near a small front gate
friendly neighbor passing by

physical_cues.learner_target: learner turns toward neighbor and answers politely

scenes.description: A classmate sees the learner before class and starts a quick greeting.

characters.description: standing with backpack or notebook
friendly classmate approaching before class

physical_cues.world_opener: classmate slows down and gives a quick wave
physical_cues.learner_target: learner shifts attention from notebook and responds
physical_cues.world_response: classmate smiles and nods before moving on

scenes.description: A staff member speaks quickly and the learner needs them to repeat slowly.

characters.description: standing at a counter looking uncertain
helpful but busy person behind the counter

physical_cues.world_opener: staff explains quickly while pointing to a form
physical_cues.learner_target: learner looks confused, raises hand gently, and asks for slower repetition
physical_cues.world_response: staff softens expression and repeats more slowly

scenes.description: The learner needs to find a bus stop in an unfamiliar area.

characters.description: holding a phone or small bag and looking around
nearby person willing to point the way

physical_cues.learner_target: learner looks around, then asks with a palm-up searching gesture
physical_cues.world_response: local points down the street and traces the route with a hand

scenes.description: The learner wants to buy a bottle of water from a shopkeeper.

characters.description: customer standing near a fridge or counter
friendly shopkeeper behind the counter

physical_cues.learner_target: learner points gently toward a water bottle and asks politely
physical_cues.world_response: shopkeeper reaches for the bottle and confirms

scenes.description: The learner points to an item at a market and asks the price.

characters.description: customer looking at goods on a stall
vendor standing behind displayed items

physical_cues.learner_target: learner points to an item and looks between item and vendor
physical_cues.world_response: vendor holds up fingers or gestures toward payment

scenes.description: The learner orders one common local food item from a friendly server.

characters.description: customer looking at visible food or a menu board
busy but friendly food counter worker

physical_cues.learner_target: learner points to a visible food item and holds up one finger
physical_cues.world_response: server nods and starts preparing or handing over the food

scenes.environment: street corner near a clinic or hospital district
scenes.description: The learner urgently asks a local person where the hospital is.

characters.description: worried person holding a phone map
nearby person who can point toward the hospital

physical_cues.learner_target: learner looks worried, shows phone, and asks with a searching gesture
physical_cues.world_response: local points firmly toward the hospital direction

scenes.description: The learner asks a pharmacist for medicine for a simple symptom.

characters.description: customer at the pharmacy counter looking uncomfortable
attentive pharmacist behind the counter

physical_cues.learner_target: learner gestures to symptom gently and asks for medicine
physical_cues.world_response: pharmacist listens carefully and reaches toward medicine shelves

scenes.description: The learner arrives with a bag and starts a simple hostel check-in.

characters.description: traveler with backpack, phone, and passport
hostel staff member at front desk

physical_cues.world_opener: receptionist looks up from desk and smiles
physical_cues.learner_target: learner shows phone booking or passport and says they have a reservation
physical_cues.world_response: receptionist checks the booking and reaches for a key

scenes.description: Two adults chat casually, and the learner makes a respectful low-pressure social invitation.

characters.description: adult sitting at a cafe table with relaxed posture
adult conversation partner with comfortable personal space

physical_cues.learner_target: learner smiles politely and gestures lightly toward the coffee cups
physical_cues.world_response: conversation partner responds clearly; learner accepts the answer respectfully
